name: Humanitarian funding gap
value: WFP 2026 appeal half funded; Sudan aid cut
summary: WFP says its 2026 appeal is half funded and 900,000 people in Sudan have lost food aid; no large-scale suspension found
state: WFP launched a $12 billion appeal for 2027 on 20 Nov targeting 91 million people, down from 110 million in 2026, and said its $13 billion 2026 appeal is only half funded (Reuters via Arab News). Funding cuts have reduced WFP's Sudan caseload from more than 4 million people in August to just over 3 million, with about 900,000 losing food assistance (UN News, 12 Nov). Major ration cuts meet Watch; no large-scale suspension of food or health aid in a famine-risk country was found as of 27 Nov.
for_you: Shortfalls fall hardest on refugees and displaced people in Sudan, Gaza, Yemen and the Sahel. Smaller rations tend to raise malnutrition, onward migration and pressure on host countries.
rubric_hit: Watch: major ration cuts — WFP 2026 appeal half funded; 900,000 lost food aid in Sudan (12 Nov)

sources.title: Arab News (Reuters) — UN cuts food aid target despite looming hunger crisis
UN News — Aid is the 'only hope' for millions in Sudan, WFP chief warns, as funding cuts deepen hunger crisis

why: When appeals go unfunded, food aid and health services are cut first; funding gaps lead famine and displacement by months.
drivers: Donor budgets and aid cuts, new crises competing for funds, access constraints.

rubric.alert: Pipeline breaks forcing large-scale suspension of food or health aid in famine-risk countries.
rubric.watch: Funding more than 10 percentage points behind recent years at the same point, or major ration cuts announced.
rubric.normal: UN global appeal funding in line with recent years; no major ration cuts.
